text:
Ivy: Heads-up: NovaCorp sent PO NC-2026-210 but billing entity is 'NovaCorp EU' while contract SOW-920 is under 'NovaCorp US'. They want consolidated billing across entities. Procurement attached a scan but GL codes are missing. Can we handle multi-entity netting?
Diego: Oof. Our standard is to invoice the legal entity on the contract. Consolidated billing requires legal review + finance approval for intercompany netting. Also need proof of authorization from both entities.
Amrita: Onboarding at 78% 10-day feature flip planned. If billing/legal hold >3 business days we should pause rollout. CSM-bot, flag customer comms.
CSM-bot: Noted. Drafted message: "Were reconciling billing entity details; short delay possible. Will confirm by EOD."
FinanceBot: Created ticket FIN-4999: "NovaCorp entity mismatch + GL missing". Requested VAT IDs for both entities and copy of intercompany agreement if any.
Ivy: Procurement claims they want a single invoice to 'NovaCorp EU' for central payments, and US entity will reimburse. They attached an internal PO note about netting. They didn't include the intercompany note.
Diego: Legal: we need written authorization from NovaCorp execs on both entities. If they provide PO from EU entity but contract is US, we can: a) amend SOW to add EU as bill-to party, or b) accept EU PO as third-party payer with a payor letter. Option (b) is quicker but needs tax/AR confirmation.
LegalBot: Drafting a short payor-letter template and SOW addendum. Payor-letter must include PO#, billing entity, VAT ID, and explicit statement authorizing NovaCorp EU to pay invoices for SOW-920.
FinanceBot: VAT IDs required. Also if we accept third-party payer we need GL mapping and confirmation that US entity remains responsible for contract terms. Added checklist to FIN-4999.
Ivy: Action: ask procurement to supply VAT IDs + an exec-signed payor letter OR request an addendum to SOW listing NovaCorp EU as bill-to. Also ask for GL codes. Diego  can you quick-check tax risk?
Diego: Tax risk: cross-border VAT depends on invoice party and VAT registration. If EU entity pays, we may need to treat as B2B intra-EU supply; finance needs EU VAT ID and reverse-charge handling. If US entity is payer, standard US tax handling. Need Finance confirmation.
Amrita: I'll tell the CSM to prep a hold message for stakeholders and delay the feature flip to next week if docs don't land by tomorrow.
Ivy: Procurement replied: they uploaded VAT IDs for both entities but didn't include a payor letter. They asked if we can accept the EU PO as payor and keep contract on US entity.
LegalBot: Uploaded payor-letter template: "/docs/payor_letters/NOVA_payor_template_v1.docx". Requested procurement to sign and have legal counsel on both sides confirm. Also suggested short addendum if they prefer to change billing entity on the contract.
FinanceBot: FIN-4999 updated: VAT IDs received; awaiting signed payor letter or SOW addendum and GL codes. Risk: tax treatment pending until payor confirmed.
Ivy: RevOps  can you confirm if we allow third-party payors for renewals? Need any system flags/AR work.
RevOps: We support third-party payors for enterprise accounts but require payor-letter + GL mapping + AR onboarding. Expect ~2 business days of processing. We can expedite if docs arrive today.
Amrita: CSM communicated hold to customer. They acknowledged and said they'd get the signed payor letter and GL codes within the day.
Diego: Once we have signed payor letter + GL codes, Legal will sign addendum or countersign payor letter, Finance will set up billing config, and enablement can proceed.
Ivy: Closing loop plan: 1) Customer to upload signed payor letter + GL codes by EOD 2) Legal to review/countersign 3) Finance to configure invoices 4) Amrita/CSM to confirm release window. I'll update thread when complete.
